name: Gemini Image Describer
tagline: Image scene description and optical character recognition (OCR) with structured analysis
description: Gemini Image Describer uses the Gemini Interactions API to analyze images and generate structured Markdown descriptions, including scene summaries, optical character recognition (OCR), and key object breakdowns. It supports JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP formats across local files, remote URLs, and data URIs.
